adapter.detect.lookpath_failed: Looking for its program on PATH failed.
adapter.detect.unreadable: A file or directory it needs is there but cannot be read.
check.cli.blocked_hint: A resource with a problem that must be fixed cannot be published.
check.cli.config_invalid:
{{file}} cannot be used, so nothing in the repository was checked:
{{detail}}
check.cli.flag.branch: With --repo: the branch, tag or commit (default: the repository's default branch)
check.cli.flag.dir: With --repo: the directory in the repository that holds the resources
check.cli.flag.repo: Check a resource repository by its address instead of a local directory
check.cli.flag.rules: Run only these rules, by ID, separated by commas
check.cli.flag.strict: Also exit with 4 when only advisory problems are found
check.cli.header_one: Checked {{count}} resource in {{source}} against rule set v{{ruleset}}
check.cli.header_other: Checked {{count}} resources in {{source}} against rule set v{{ruleset}}
check.cli.long:
PATH is a resource repository, a directory in one, or one resource; the default is the current directory. The rules are the ones the server runs before anything is published.

Exit code 0: nothing must be fixed. Exit code 4: something must be fixed, or with --strict, anything was found.
check.cli.no_rules: This build of {{cli}} has no check rules.
check.cli.not_a_repository: {{path}} is not in a resource repository: there is no {{file}} there or in any directory above it.
check.cli.repo_and_path: Give either a path or --repo, not both.
check.cli.short: Check resources before they are published, with the rules the server uses
check.cli.unknown_rule: There is no rule "{{rule}}". The rules are: {{rules}}.
completion.long:
Load it in the current shell:

  bash:        source <({{cli}} completion bash)
  zsh:         source <({{cli}} completion zsh)
  fish:        {{cli}} completion fish | source
  PowerShell:  {{cli}} completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load it in every new shell, add that line to your shell's startup file.
completion.short: Print the completion script for bash, zsh, fish or powershell
config.bad_value: "{{value}}" is not a valid value for {{key}}: {{reason}}
config.flag_only: "{{key}}" is not a setting: it can only be given on the command line, as {{flag}}, each time.
config.get.short: Show the value of one setting
config.list.short: Show every setting, its value and where the value comes from
config.not_in_file: "{{key}}" cannot be kept in the configuration file. Use {{ways}}.
config.reason.lang: use a language tag such as en or zh-CN
config.reason.url: use an address that starts with https:// or http://
config.set.long:
A list takes its items separated by commas, such as: {{cli}} config set tools.disabled opencode,codex
An empty value removes the setting from the file, and the default applies again.
config.set.overridden: {{origin}} is set right now and takes precedence over the file for {{key}}.
config.set.short: Change a setting in the local configuration file
config.short: Show and change the local configuration
config.unknown_key: Unknown setting "{{key}}". Run "{{cli}} config list" to see every setting.
config.warn.flag_only: Ignoring {{key}} in {{origin}}: it only counts when given on the command line as {{flag}}.
config.warn.not_in_file: Ignoring "{{key}}" in {{origin}}: it cannot be kept in the configuration file.
config.warn.unknown_key: Ignoring "{{key}}" in {{origin}}: this version does not know it.
disable.already: {{resource}} is already off on this computer.
disable.required: {{resource}} is required by your team and cannot be turned off. Only the people who maintain the resource repository can change that.
disable.short: Turn off a recommended resource on this computer; the next sync removes it

doctor.config.env_invalid: The environment variable {{name}} has the value "{{value}}", which is not valid.
doctor.config.ignored_hint: Run "{{cli}} config list" to see the settings in effect.
doctor.config.missing: There is no {{path}}; the defaults apply.

doctor.config.unreadable_hint: Nothing overwrites it. Fix the file or move it away; until then, the commands that need the configuration stop.
doctor.git.broken_hint: Check that {{path}} is a working Git, or set {{env}} to another one.
doctor.git.missing: No git program was found on PATH.
doctor.git.missing_hint: Syncing straight from a resource repository needs Git. Install it, or set {{env}} to the path of the git program.
doctor.git.not_found: The git program {{path}} does not exist or cannot be run.
doctor.git.title: Git
doctor.home.missing: {{path}} does not exist yet. The first sync creates it.
doctor.home.not_dir_hint: Move it somewhere else: {{cli}} keeps its records in a directory of that name.
doctor.home.ok: {{path}} exists and only you can open it.
doctor.home.title: Local data directory
doctor.home.unknown: Cannot tell where the local data directory is: {{detail}}
doctor.home.unknown_hint: Set {{env}} to an absolute path, or use --home.
doctor.intents.busy: Another {{cli}} is changing things right now, so this cannot be checked.
doctor.intents.busy_hint: Run the check again when it has finished.
doctor.intents.none: None: every write was finished and recorded.
doctor.intents.pending_hint: The next sync finishes or drops each one whose target it can recognise; the rest stay listed here. Look at these paths before changing them by hand.
doctor.intents.pending_one: {{count}} write was started and not recorded in the manifest.
doctor.intents.pending_other: {{count}} writes were started and not recorded in the manifest.
doctor.intents.title: Unfinished writes
doctor.intents.unreadable: The intent log {{path}} cannot be read: {{detail}}
doctor.intents.unreadable_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it lists writes that may be half done.
doctor.keyring.file_hint: Anyone who can read your files, or a backup of them, can act as this device. Once a system keychain is available (on Linux, a Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring in a desktop session), log out and log in again with {{cli}} to keep them there. Nothing moves by itself.
doctor.keyring.plain_file: The device key and token are kept in files in {{path}} that only you can read, not in a system keychain.
doctor.keyring.protected_file: The device key and token are kept in files in {{path}}, encrypted for your Windows account, not in the Credential Manager.
doctor.keyring.reason: There is no system keychain to use: {{detail}}
doctor.keyring.system: The device key and token are kept in the system keychain.
doctor.keyring.title: System keychain
doctor.keyring.too_open: Others can open {{path}}, so it is not used until that is fixed.
doctor.keyring.unavailable: The device key and token are kept in the system keychain, which cannot be reached now: {{detail}}
doctor.keyring.unavailable_hint: Until it can be reached, {{cli}} cannot act as this device; it deletes and regenerates nothing meanwhile. On Linux, log in to the desktop session or start the Secret Service; over SSH on macOS, unlock the keychain with "security unlock-keychain".
doctor.keyring.unreadable: Cannot tell whether the device key and token can be read: {{detail}}
doctor.keyring.unreadable_hint: Nothing is deleted or regenerated while this lasts. If the keychain is locked, unlock it and run the check again.
doctor.leftovers.found_hint: Nothing uses them. Delete them while no {{cli}} is running.
doctor.leftovers.found_one: {{count}} temporary file or directory was left behind by a run that did not finish.
doctor.leftovers.found_other: {{count}} temporary files or directories were left behind by runs that did not finish.
doctor.leftovers.title: Temporary files
doctor.manifest.invalid: {{path}} does not hold what a manifest should: {{detail}}
doctor.manifest.missing: Nothing has been written yet ({{path}} does not exist).
doctor.manifest.newer: {{path}} was written by a newer version of {{cli}}.
doctor.manifest.newer_hint: Use that newer version, or a later one. This one changes nothing until then.
doctor.manifest.previous_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it is the only record of what was written. The manifest as it was before the last write is {{previous}}.
doctor.manifest.title: Manifest
doctor.manifest.unknown_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it is the only record of what was written.
doctor.short: Check this computer: local data directory, manifest, Git and the AI tools
doctor.skipped_no_home: Not checked: where the local data directory is is not known.
doctor.summary: {{ok}} passed · {{warn}} to look at · {{fail}} failed · {{unknown}} could not be checked
doctor.tool_roots.none: No installed tool to look at.
doctor.tool_roots.ok: The directories of {{tool}} can be written to.
doctor.tool_roots.outside: {{path}} is a symbolic link to {{target}}, outside your home directory.

doctor.tool_roots.title: Tool directories
doctor.tools.disabled: {{tool}} is switched off in the local configuration ({{key}}).
doctor.tools.installed_no_version: {{tool}} is installed; its version could not be read.
doctor.tools.newer: {{tool}} {{version}} is newer than {{verified}}, the version its support was checked against.
doctor.tools.newer_hint: Syncing still works. If something ends up in the wrong place, please report it.
doctor.tools.none: This build of {{cli}} supports no AI tool.
doctor.tools.title: AI tools
doctor.tools.unknown_hint: {{cli}} leaves {{tool}} alone until this can be read.
doctor.tools.unverified: {{tool}} is installed, but its support has not been checked against the real tool yet, so {{cli}} writes nothing to it.
enable.required: {{resource}} is required: it is always installed.
enable.short: Turn on an optional resource on this computer; the next sync installs it
error.bad_lang: "{{value}}" is not a language tag. Use one such as en or zh-CN.

error.env_invalid: The environment variable {{name}} has the value "{{value}}", which is not valid: {{reason}}.

error.locked: Another {{cli}} is changing things on this computer right now. Nothing was changed; try again when it has finished.

flag.branch: Branch, tag or commit of the resource repository (default: repo.branch, else the repository's default branch)
flag.diff: Show how changed files differ from what the resource repository wants
flag.dir: Directory inside the resource repository that holds the resources
flag.exit_code: With --plan: exit with 5 when there is something to change
flag.json: Print one machine-readable JSON document on standard output
flag.lang: Interface language, such as en or zh-CN
flag.non_interactive: Never ask; treat every question as answered "no"
flag.overwrite: Overwrite this resource even where it was changed on this computer; your version is kept in kept/ first (repeatable)
flag.product: Product whose resources you want, by its code (repeatable; default: repo.products)
flag.quiet: Say less: only warnings and errors
flag.repo: Resource repository to sync from: an https or ssh address, or a local path (default: repo.url)
flag.skip_global: Write only new files; change no tool's global configuration
flag.status_exit_code: Exit with 5 when a sync would change anything
flag.sync_plan: Only show what would be written; change nothing
flag.tool: Only this AI tool, by its identifier (repeatable)
flag.uninstall_plan: Only show what would be removed; change nothing
flag.uninstall_tool: Only undo what was written for this AI tool (repeatable)
flag.yes_global: Agree to every change of global configuration in this sync, without being asked. Counts only on the command line
help.more: Run "{{command}} <command> --help" for more about a command.
plan.group.global: Needs your consent: changing global configuration (the original files are backed up to {{backup}} first)
plan.group.global_agreed: Changing global configuration you agreed to before (the original files are backed up to {{backup}} first)
plan.group.new: New files and directories (all start with {{prefix}})
plan.no_tools: No AI tool found on this computer
plan.note.deleted: deleted on this computer, not put back; to restore it: {{command}}
plan.note.modified: changed on this computer, not overwritten; to overwrite it (your version is kept): {{command}}
plan.note.overwrite: changed on this computer; your version is kept in {{kept}} first
plan.note.remove_kept: changed on this computer; a copy goes to {{kept}}
plan.note.restore: deleted on this computer, put back
plan.note.shared_loses: {{tools}} read it too and lose it until their next sync
plan.note.taken: already there and not written by {{cli}}: it is yours, so it is left alone
plan.nothing: Nothing to change: everything is as wanted
plan.resource_failed: cannot be read from the repository ({{issues}}); what was written for it stays as it is
plan.run_hint_global: Run "{{command}}" to write this; "{{skip}}" writes only the new files
plan.skip.name_taken: the name is taken by something of yours
plan.skip.needs_secret: needs a personal secret this tool cannot be given without a server yet
plan.skip.path_too_long: the path would be too long for Windows
plan.skip.unsupported: this tool has no place for it
plan.skip.unwritable: the tool's configuration file cannot be written
plan.tool_disabled: {{tool}}: switched off in the local configuration ({{key}})
plan.tool_failed: {{tool}}: could not be planned, nothing written or removed: {{detail}}
plan.tool_unknown: {{tool}}: cannot tell whether it is installed ({{detail}}); left as it is
plan.tool_unreadable: {{tool}}: left as it is, because something it needs cannot be read: {{detail}}
plan.total_one: To be written: {{count}} place · nothing has been changed yet
plan.total_other: To be written: {{count}} places · nothing has been changed yet
plan.untouched: Not changed: your own skills, your own MCP servers, hooks (not installed by default), project directories
root.short: Sync your team's AI coding resources into the AI tools on this computer, and undo it cleanly
selection.reason.not_enabled: it is optional and not turned on
selection.reason.personal: it is someone's personal resource, which needs a server
selection.reason.product: it belongs to a product you did not choose (--product or repo.products)
selection.unreadable: {{resource}} cannot be read from the repository ({{path}}), so whether it may be turned on or off cannot be told. Nothing was changed.
selection.write_failed: Cannot save what you turned on and off: {{detail}}
source.incompatible: The resource repository {{url}} needs a newer {{cli}}: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
source.no_git: Syncing from a resource repository needs Git: {{detail}}. Install it, or set {{env}} to the git program.
source.no_ref: The resource repository {{url}} has no such branch, tag, commit or directory: {{detail}}
source.none: There is nothing to sync from: give --repo <address>, or set it once with "{{cli}} config set {{key}} <address>".
source.not_a_repo: {{url}} is not a resource repository: it has no {{file}}.
source.unreachable: Cannot reach the resource repository {{url}}: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed, nothing removed.

status.diff.binary: (not text; the lines are not shown)
status.diff.heading: {{path}}  (- as the repository has it, + as it is on this computer)
status.diff.unavailable: Nothing to compare with: the repository was not read, or this is a configuration key.
status.empty: Nothing has been written on this computer.
status.group.deleted: Deleted on this computer (a sync does not put it back)
status.group.modified: Changed on this computer (a sync does not overwrite it)
status.group.outdated: Newer in the repository (a sync updates it)
status.group.pending: Not here yet (a sync writes it)
status.group.removing: No longer wanted (a sync removes it)
status.hint.modified: to overwrite it (your version is kept): {{command}}
status.no_diff: Nothing differs from what the repository wants.
status.no_source: No resource repository configured: compared with what was written only
status.no_such_resource: Nothing is known about {{resource}}: it is neither installed nor in the repository.

status.source_failed: The resource repository could not be read, so only what was written is compared: {{detail}}
status.source_unavailable: Resource repository not available: compared with what was written only
status.sync_hint: Run "{{command}}" to see what a sync would change.
sync.ask: Change {{file}} for {{tool}} ({{keys}})? The original is backed up to {{backup}} first. [y/N]
sync.deferred_hint: These wait for your consent. Run "{{command}}" to make them, or run the sync in a terminal to be asked.
sync.deferred_skipped: These were left out (--skip-global). Run "{{command}}" without it to make them.
sync.done_one: Done: {{count}} place changed · the manifest is {{manifest}}
sync.done_other: Done: {{count}} places changed · the manifest is {{manifest}}
sync.group.deferred: Waiting for your consent: not changed
sync.group.retry: Changed by another program while syncing: not written
sync.kept: Your changed versions are kept in {{path}}
sync.nothing: Nothing to change: everything is as wanted
sync.overwrite_unknown: --overwrite {{resource}}: the repository has no such resource.
sync.preview_failed: Trying the plan out in a temporary copy failed, so nothing was written: {{detail}}
sync.short: Write your team's resources into the AI tools on this computer (--plan only shows what would change)
sync.skip_and_yes: --skip-global and --yes-global contradict each other; give one of them.
sync.write_failed_hint: What was written so far is in the manifest; the next sync goes on from there, or uninstall undoes it.
uninstall.failed: Undoing stopped: {{detail}}. What is left is still in the manifest; run uninstall again.
uninstall.group.global: Global configuration: only the keys {{cli}} added are removed (the original files are backed up to {{backup}} first)
uninstall.group.retry: Changed by another program while uninstalling: left as it is
uninstall.home_entries_left: {{home}} stays: the manifest still records writes that were not undone.
uninstall.home_kept: Everything else is gone, but your changed versions are still in {{kept}}. Delete that directory once you no longer need them.
uninstall.home_not_empty: {{home}} stays: it holds things {{cli}} did not put there ({{names}}).
uninstall.home_tool: {{home}} stays: other tools' writes are still recorded in it.
uninstall.nothing: Nothing to undo: the manifest records nothing.
uninstall.run_hint: Run "{{command}}" to undo this; {{home}} is deleted afterwards.
uninstall.run_hint_tool: Run "{{command}}" with the same --tool to undo this.
uninstall.short: Undo everything written to the AI tools on this computer, by the manifest
uninstall.total_one: To be undone: {{count}} place · nothing has been changed yet
uninstall.total_other: To be undone: {{count}} places · nothing has been changed yet
uninstall.untouched: Not touched: anything not in the manifest, even with the prefix {{prefix}}
version.short: Show the version, commit, build time and platform
